Class EventManager

java.lang.Object
dev.despical.kotl.api.EventManager
@Internal public final class EventManager extends Object
Central dispatcher for KOTL custom events.

The manager invokes Bukkit listeners synchronously, records optional timing information, and validates named event factories against EventType. External plugins should listen to the concrete event classes rather than manually invoking the lifecycle factory methods in this class.
